jobs.occupation: Global Procurement Specialist / Strategic Buyer (m/f/d) (Fachkaufmann/-frau - Einkauf und Logistik)
jobs.description:
About us European Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (ESMC) GmbH is
the joint venture between TSMC, Bosch, Infineon and NXP. For the first
time, global technology leader TSMC is building a semiconductor fab in
the heart of Europe, offering cutting-edge manufacturing technologies
for next-generation semiconductor products. ESMC represents a shared
commitment to strengthening the European semiconductor ecosystem. For
our future fab in Dresden, we are looking for a highly motivated and
committed: Global Procurement Specialist / Strategic Buyer (m/f/d) Are
you ready to secure the supply chain for Europe’s pioneer
semiconductor Greenfield project? As a Global Procurement Specialist /
Strategic Buyer, you will take ownership of the commercial end-to-end
sourcing process for critical materials supporting our brand-new
manufacturing site in Dresden. You will negotiate high-volume global
contracts, mitigate supply chain risks, and build resilient
partnerships with key international suppliers. If you thrive at the
intersection of business strategy, cross-functional collaboration, and
high-tech operations, this role offers you the ultimate platform to
make a global impact. Tasks Strategic Sourcing: Develop, negotiate,
and execute end-to-end global sourcing strategies and contracts to
ensure a highly resilient, cost-effective supply of critical
materials. Supplier Partnership Management: Build and nurture
long-term strategic relationships with a global supplier base to
secure high-quality materials and services. Commercial Negotiation:
Lead commercial negotiations, drive total cost of ownership (TCO)
optimization, and actively manage commercial risks. Performance
Monitoring : Evaluate and manage supplier performance against key
quality, delivery, cost, and risk metrics to ensure full contract
compliance. Risk & Supply Resilience: Proactively identify and resolve
supplier-related issues, including delivery disruptions and quality
deviations, using data-driven preventive actions. Cross-Functional
Alignment: Collaborate closely with engineering, fab operations,
finance, and HQ procurement teams to align sourcing activities with
production budgets and timelines. Process Excellence: Contribute to
continuous improvement initiatives to streamline procurement workflows
and scale up supply chain operations. Governance & ESG: Ensure strict
compliance with all internal policies, contractual obligations, trade
laws, and ESG standards across all purchasing activities. Profile
Required: Education: Bachelor’s degree or higher in Supply Chain
Management, Industrial Engineering, Business Administration, IT, or a
related field. Experience: Minimum of 4 years of strategic procurement
or supply chain experience within an international industrial setting.
Negotiation Skills: Proven track record in commercial negotiations,
contract management, and strategic supplier evaluation. Languages:
Proficiency in English (C1) and German (C1) is required for seamless
collaboration with local and global stakeholders. Mindset: Strong
analytical thinking, attention to detail in contract review, and the
ability to coordinate multiple complex projects simultaneously.
International Onboarding: Willingness to complete an intensive
training of 3-6 months at TSMC Taiwan. Nice to have: Industry
Knowledge: Prior experience in the semiconductor, chemical, or
advanced materials industry. Certifications: Professional supply chain
or procurement certifications (e.g., APICS CPIM/CSCP, ISM CPSM).
Global Mindset: Experience in collaborating with Asian business
environments; Mandarin language skills are a plus. Why Join ESMC? Help
build a completely new semiconductor manufacturing site in Europe.
Work in a highly international environment with colleagues across the
world. Shape processes instead of maintaining existing structures.
Participate in global projects and cross-functional collaboration.
Additional contact details Please apply with an English resume.

jobs.occupation: Clinical Trial Disclosure Lead (m/w/d) (Referent/in - klinische Studien (CRA))
jobs.description:
Randstad is one of the world's leading talent companies with the
ambition to be the world's most equitable and specialized talent
company. Through our "partner for talent" corporate strategy, we find,
develop and connect specialized talents with companies - worldwide,
locally and always at a high speed. We build high-quality, diverse,
and agile teams, while individuals can enjoy a rewarding career path
with equitable opportunities.

Randstad Professional is one of Randstad's four specializations
and focuses on the placement of specialists and managers in the
future-oriented sectors of IT, Engineering, Life Science and Office.

Are you passionate about transparency in clinical research and eager
to ensure that global study data meets the highest regulatory
standards?

We are currently looking for a Clinical Trial Disclosure Lead (m/f/d)
for our pharmaceutical client in Monheim am Rhein (fully remote
possible). In this role, you will independently manage the entire
process of clinical trial registration and results disclosure at the
study level.

This position is available via temporary employment
(Arbeitnehmerüberlassung) for 18 months, with the option of contract
extension.

- ​​Strategy & Planning: Define disclosure strategies early at
study concept, protocol, and amendment stages.
- Registrations & Submissions: Prepare, review, and submit clinical
trial registrations across global registries such as CTIS and
ClinicalTrials.gov.
- Lifecycle Management: Maintain accurate, up-to-date, and compliant
registry records throughout the entire study lifecycle.
- Results Disclosures: Coordinate the creation and submission of
clinical trial results disclosures.
- Compliance & Audits: Ensure full inspection readiness through
precise documentation and auditable evidence.
- Operations & Oversight: Support data quality, system maintenance,
and vendor oversight activities.
- Remote: 3 days/week or 100% remote possible
- Education & Experience: Degree in Life Sciences (or a related
discipline) with a background in clinical research, trial management,
Regulatory Affairs, or project management.
- Technical Expertise: Knowledge of clinical trial transparency and
disclosure requirements, familiarity with registries such as CTIS or
ClinicalTrials.gov, and strong affinity for IT systems. (Experience at
a CRO or Sponsor is a plus).
- Languages: Fluent English (must-have); German skills are a
nice-to-have.
- Soft Skills: High attention to detail, strong organizational
skills, proactive communication, and an open, collaborative mindset.
- Attractive salary and long-term job security through affiliation
with the Group
- Up to 30 days vacation per year
- Good chances of being taken on by our business partners
- Targeted training opportunities and free language courses

About us European Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (ESMC) GmbH is
the joint venture between TSMC, Bosch, Infineon and NXP. For the first
time, global technology leader TSMC is building a semiconductor fab in
the heart of Europe, offering cutting-edge manufacturing technologies
for next-generation semiconductor products. ESMC represents a shared
commitment to strengthening the European semiconductor ecosystem. For
our future fab in Dresden, we are looking for a highly motivated and
committed: Chemical Quality & Laboratory Engineer (m/f/d) Are you
ready to design, build, and run a state-of-the-art analytical
chemistry laboratory from the ground up? As a Chemical Quality &
Laboratory Engineer (m/f/d) at ESMC, you will be key to establishing
our chemical laboratory infrastructure in Dresden. Starting on January 2027, you will manage our analytical instruments, set up
testing standards, and verify the quality of incoming materials and
facility chemical systems. Collaborating closely with our advanced
teams in Taiwan and leading a small group of local technicians, you
will directly safeguard the production quality of Europe's newest
premier semiconductor fab! Tasks Lab Infrastructure Setup: Design,
establish, and optimize our on-site chemical lab capacity, process
setups, and analytical capabilities. Instrument Management: Lead the
operation, calibration, and maintenance of high-precision analytical
equipment, with a focus on ICP-MS, GC-MS, PTR-MS, and Ion
Chromatography (IC). Material Quality Control: Execute routine and
event-triggered monitoring of incoming chemicals and raw materials to
ensure strict compliance with manufacturing standards. Technical
Writing: Define Operational Instructions (OIs) and Standard Operating
Procedures (SOPs) for the laboratory environment. Team Leadership:
Supervise, train, and coordinate a small, dedicated group of
laboratory technicians. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with
fab and facility teams to troubleshoot chemical events, support
continuous improvement projects (CIP), and verify tool certifications.
Emergency On-Duty Support: Participate in weekend and night-shift
on-duty rotations to handle urgent chemical safety or quality
escalations. Profile Must-Have: Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s
degree in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Material Science, or a
related scientific discipline. Technical Experience: 0 to 3 years of
hands-on experience in chemical analysis, with deep knowledge of
analytical techniques such as ICP-MS, GC-MS, PTR-MS, or Ion
Chromatography (IC). Analytical Skillset: Experience in standard
sample preparation, calibration curves, statistical process control
(SPC) data interpretation, and analytical instrument troubleshooting.
Soft Skills: Strong collaborative mindset, intercultural openness,
resilience under pressure, and a structured, detail-oriented approach
to safety and quality. Languages: Fluency in English (written and
spoken) is required. Nice-to-Have: Prior experience in a semiconductor
manufacturing environment or cleanroom chemical lab management.
Knowledge of European chemical regulations (such as REACH) and safety
standards. Basic programming skills (e.g., Python, R, or SQL) for
analytical data processing. Basic communication skills in German
and/or Mandarin. We offer Security & Perspective: A permanent
employment contract and career advancement opportunities in one of
Europe's leading semiconductors fabs. Company Pension Plan & Financial
Benefits: We support your financial well-being with our robust company
pension plan. As an ESMC employee, you also benefit directly from
TSMC’s performance through an exclusive Employee Stock Purchase Plan
(ESPP). Training & Development: At the TSMC Newcomer Training Center,
gain a deeper understanding of the processes involved in operating
complex semiconductor equipment through unique hands-on training,
while you continuously expand your knowledge. Health & Well-Being: An
annual budget for your health and well-being (e.g., for sports
classes, massages, or relaxation) helps you stay fit. Meals &
Transportation: Enjoy a daily meal allowance as well as a subsidized
public transportation (e.g., for the Deutschlandticket). Additional
contact details Please apply with your english resume.

About us European Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (ESMC) GmbH is
the joint venture between TSMC, Bosch, Infineon and NXP. For the first
time, global technology leader TSMC is building a semiconductor fab in
the heart of Europe, offering cutting-edge manufacturing technologies
for next-generation semiconductor products. ESMC represents a shared

our future fab in Dresden, we are looking for a highly motivated and
committed: Supplier Quality Engineer – Semiconductor Materials
(m/f/d) Starting on January 27, you can become a key safeguard for
Europe’s newest, most advanced semiconductor manufacturing process.
As a Supplier Quality Engineer – Semiconductor Materials (m/f/d) at
ESMC, you will be responsible for ensuring the quality and reliability
of all incoming materials and services used in our Dresden fabrication
facility. By collaborating with global suppliers and our internal
engineering, procurement, and laboratory teams, you will establish a
stable quality baseline that matches our mother fabs in Taiwan. This
role is an exciting opportunity to combine your technical knowledge of
material science with supplier management and big data analytics to
protect our production from material excursions! Tasks Incoming
Quality Assurance: Establish and maintain a stable statistical
baseline for incoming materials and services to ensure local wafer
quality aligns with our international mother fabs. Supplier Quality
Management: Conduct comprehensive supplier quality system assessments,
onsite audits, risk management, and process change control (PCN)
reviews. Excursion Prevention: Utilize statistical process control
(SPC) data and key performance indicators (KPIs) to proactively
monitor supplier performance and prevent material deviations.
Collaborative Problem Solving: Lead cross-functional troubleshooting
teams alongside suppliers and internal laboratory, facility, and
procurement departments to quickly resolve quality issues.
Cross-Border Alignment: Align requirements and share Best Known
Methods (BKMs) across different time zones, communicating effectively
with internal management and executive supplier representatives.
Continuous Improvement: Build trust-based, professional relationships
with suppliers to encourage proactive transparency and continuous
quality improvements. Profile Must-Have: Education: Bachelor’s or
Master’s degree in Material Science, Material Engineering,
Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Physics, or a closely related
technical field. Experience: 0 to 3 years of professional experience,
ideally in the semiconductor industry or related high-tech sectors
(e.g., photovoltaics, chemicals, pharmaceuticals). Core Technical
Skills: Familiarity with basic material quality management,
statistical data analysis, or process change control. Interpersonal &
Communication Skills: High intercultural open-mindedness, strong
initiative, and the confidence to communicate effectively with
international teams and senior management. Languages: Fluent in
English (written and spoken) is required. Nice-to-Have: Practical
experience in semiconductor fabrication operations, process
engineering, or physical/chemical laboratory analysis. Familiarity
with structured problem-solving methods (e.g., 8D, 5 Whys) and
supplier auditing. Basic conversational skills in German and/or
Mandarin. We offer Security & Perspective: A permanent employment
contract and career advancement opportunities in one of Europe's
leading semiconductors fabs. Company Pension Plan & Financial
Benefits: We support your financial well-being with our robust company
pension plan. As an ESMC employee, you also benefit directly from
TSMC’s performance through an exclusive Employee Stock Purchase Plan
(ESPP). Relocation Support for Dresden: Moving for us? We’ll provide
you with all the support you will need for your relocation and your
start in Dresden. Training & Development: At the TSMC Newcomer
Training Center, gain a deeper understanding of the processes involved
in operating complex semiconductor equipment through unique hands-on
training, while you continuously expand your knowledge. Health &
Well-Being: An annual budget for your health and well-being (e.g., for
sports classes, massages, or relaxation) helps you stay fit. Meals &
Transportation: Enjoy a daily meal allowance as well as a subsidized
public transportation (e.g., for the Deutschlandticket). Additional
contact details Please apply with your english resume.

Overlay). Simultaneously, you will drive our Statistical Process

statistical analysis in a brand-new, state-of-the-art semiconductor

accuracy of critical inline metrology tools (including CDSEM, OCD, and

Matching: Develop, implement, and monitor calibration and cross-fab
matching methods to guarantee uniform measurements across all
metrology tools. SPC System Enhancement: Drive the continuous
improvement of SPC systems, including control limit setup, CPK
monitoring, process audits, and data analysis. Statistical Analysis &
Risk Prevention: Apply advanced statistical methods (such as Design of
Experiments (DOE), sampling plans, and reliability modeling) to
predict risks and resolve quality issues. Data-Driven Development:
Program and develop custom statistical algorithms and analysis scripts
to automate quality monitoring and defense reporting. HQ
Collaboration: Partner with engineering teams at our Taiwan
headquarters to align local metrology and SPC standards with global
best practices. Profile Must-Have: Education: Bachelor’s or
Master’s degree in Material Engineering, Statistics, Industrial
Engineering, Physics, or a closely related technical field.
Professional Background: 0 to 3 years of experience in high-tech
manufacturing, ideally within the semiconductor industry. Statistical
Foundation: Strong knowledge of Statistical Process Control (SPC)
procedures, CPK analysis, and statistical evaluation techniques.
Programming Skills: Proficiency in statistical software/programming
languages such as JMP or R. Languages: Fluent in English (written and
spoken) for everyday communication in our international company.
Onboarding: Readiness to participate in an extended, hands-on training
assignment in Taiwan. Nice-to-Have: Hands-on experience with metrology
tools (CDSEM, OCD, or Overlay inspection systems). Programming skills
in Python. A certified Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt. Basic
conversational skills in German and/or Mandarin. We offer Help build a
completely new semiconductor manufacturing site in Europe. Work in a
highly international environment with colleagues across Europe, Taiwan
and the US. Shape processes instead of maintaining existing
structures. Participate in global projects and cross-functional
collaboration. International onboarding including 9-12 months of
training in Taiwan. Additional contact details Please apply with your
english resume.

jobs.occupation: Seasoned Veterans - Projekt Management / PMO for ERP implementation (m/f/d) (Projektleiter/in / Projektmanager/in)
jobs.description:
Would you like to do more than simply observe and instead actively contribute to challenging transformation projects in an international environment?

Who We Are

We are a specialized boutique consultancy in the field of digital transformation, with a focus on:

- Process management
- Project management
- Quality assurance in ERP projects
- ERP solution architecture in the Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations environment
- Data analytics and business intelligence

Our projects are primarily conducted in international contexts and combine functional, technical and organizational perspectives.

Who We Are Looking For

We are looking for motivated seasoned veterans (m/f/d) who have extensive professional experience and would like to learn something new in the areas of project management (Office) and control tower functions in ERP implementation projects.

What You Should Bring

- Curiosity and intrinsic motivation to learn something new again
- A strong willingness to learn and work independently
- Interest in digital business processes and ERP systems
- Very good German and good English language skills, as our projects have an international focus
- A structured and analytical way of thinking

Prior experience in project management or Microsoft Dynamics 365 is beneficial, but not a mandatory requirement.

Your Responsibilities

- Supporting the analysis and optimization of business processes
- Contributing to ERP implementation projects
- Assisting with project management and quality assurance activities
- Contributing to the design and documentation of solution architectures
- Independently working on clearly defined subject areas

From the very beginning, you will work on real client projects and take on responsibility, while receiving appropriate guidance and regular professional exchange.

What We Offer

- A personal, appreciative and relaxed working and learning environment
- Plenty of freedom to independently explore new topics
- Direct collaboration with executive management
- Insights into international transformation projects
- Flexible working arrangements
- Prospects for future permanent employment

But what’s even more important is that we’ll prepare you for your new challenge. With us, you’ll receive structured on-the-job training in project management and project methodologies for ERP implementation projects, along with the corresponding certifications.

Our ambition is not only to deliver successful projects, but also to support the professional development of people.

If you are interested in growing in an entrepreneurial environment and actively contributing to digital transformation, we look forward to receiving your application, including a brief motivation letter and your CV.

About us European Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (ESMC) GmbH is
the joint venture between TSMC, Bosch, Infineon and NXP. For the first
time, global technology leader TSMC is building a semiconductor fab in
the heart of Europe, offering cutting-edge manufacturing technologies
for next-generation semiconductor products. ESMC represents a shared
commitment to strengthening the European semiconductor ecosystem. For
our future fab in Dresden, we are looking for a highly motivated and
committed: Facilities Technician / Betriebstechniker (Electrical
Systems) (m/f/d) As Facilities Technician you are responsible for
operating, maintaining, and troubleshooting of electrical systems for
all power up to and including 110kV including Site Substations,
Service Entry Sections, Electrical switchgear, Panelboards,
Transformers, cabling systems, metering circuits, diesel generators,
uninterruptable power supply (UPS), Power Distribution Unit (PDU),
Remote Power Panel (RPP), and Static Transfer Switch (STS) as well as
motor connections, Motors and electrical controls. You play the
pivotal role to ensure standard operating procedures are followed
accurately and reliably to ensure our fab follows highest
environmental protection standards. By performing laboratory testing
and systematic verification and alignment of measurements from various
instruments, sensors, and equipment our fab can run smoothly thanks to
your work. Tasks Maintains a clean, orderly, and safe workplace,
follow all safety policies and procedures at all times and make
recommendations for continuous improvement of work method, safety,
materials-, and tool handling. Monitors operation of the mechanical /
electrical operating equipment. Observes gauges, signals and recording
instruments turns valves, moves controls to regulate temperatures,
pressures, flow of heating water, coolant to effectively monitor
critical limits. Performs standard diagnostics, monitor site
performance indicators and perform Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for
interruptions or incidents. Performs troubleshooting, emergency and
corrective maintenance and repair actions. Performs diagnostic to
determine root cause and corrective actions needed to maintain systems
operation within specifications in conformity with plant standards.
Maintains log of gauge readings, shift throughput, and equipment
malfunctions. Patrols area to inspect equipment and record tank levels

As the leading company in the field of software solutions for healthcare, we operate in 19 countries and employ over 9,000 dedicated staff members. You will work in a dynamic and innovative environment full of opportunities. With your commitment and passion, you have the chance to make a sustainable difference.

CGM Leverages AI: We’re looking for people who feel the power of AI in the e-health environment, who want to help shape change, and who are driven by a curious passion to see how technology can make healthcare smarter, simpler, and better.

Together, we are shaping the healthcare system of the future. Become part of our mission and make a difference - for a world where knowledge saves lives!

Are you passionate about groundbreaking products? Do you have the talent to turn ideas into real, valuable solutions-while always keeping the bigger picture in mind? Then we’d love to meet you!

You take end-to-end accountability for a large, distributed engineering organization that owns our ambulatory SaaS solutions and the shared framework modules used across all AIS DE products.

You co-define and drive the strategic product-technology roadmap for our cloud-based ambulatory portfolio in close collaboration with the executive leadership team.

You ensure that healthcare regulatory requirements-including medical device regulations, audits, and compliance-are rigorously embedded into product development, delivery, and operations.

You lead senior leaders and cross-functional teams, continuously increasing scalability, quality, AI maturity, and innovation velocity across products and platforms.

You represent the domain internally and externally, build strong executive-level stakeholder relationships, and position CGM as a leading SaaS provider in the Health-IT market.

Long-standing leadership experience at Director / VP / CTO level in SaaS product development, ideally with responsibility for large, distributed engineering organizations and complex product portfolios.

Exceptional academic background with a completed university degree and excellent grades, preferably in computer science, medical informatics, engineering, or a comparable technical field.

Deep expertise in cloud architectures and SaaS platforms, including modern DevOps practices and reliability engineering; hands-on experience with healthcare regulations (medical devices, audits, certifications) is a strong advantage.

Proven track record of driving AI adoption in engineering organizations, ideally with first-hand familiarity of Claude Code or comparable agentic coding tools (agents, skills, and workflows) and experience shaping AI pipelines, harnesses, and context engineering at organizational scale.

Excellent English and very good German, a strategic and entrepreneurial mindset, strong execution focus, outstanding leadership and communication skills, and the ability to guide complex organizations through transformation while staying clearly aligned with our healthcare purpose.

Mobile work: Work flexibly on the move two days a week and on site three days a week.

Attractive locations: In addition to fully equipped workplaces, regular events such as summer parties and Christmas parties await you at our locations.

Development: Our in-house academy and our portfolio of external cooperation partners will support you in your further development.

Health: Health is a valuable asset for us. Our in-house canteen offers a selection of tasty and healthy dishes every day, and we welcome you to our fully equipped fitness center for weekly courses (online & offline).

More is always possible: The kindergarten on our CGM campus in Koblenz helps our employees to organize their working day even more flexibly. We also offer corporate benefits, the option of a job bike, a company pension scheme, and much more.

Diversity is part of CGM! We look forward to receiving your application regardles...
